title: Minuta 2026-02-05
summary: The minutes of the 5 February meeting record a unanimous pause, holding the rate at 7.00% after five consecutive 25bp cuts, with Heath rejoining the majority (his only dissent is on the communique's wording, not the rate). Read against the 5 February communique (composite +0.5), the minutes come across meaningfully MORE DOVISH: three of the five members frame the pause as a temporary interruption and explicitly signal room to resume easing -- one says the pause 'pudiera incluso ser mas corta de lo previsto' and another that 'existe espacio para continuar con los recortes' -- because they judge the January IEPS and tariff increases to be one-off, focalized relative-price adjustments without second-round effects, supported by ample slack, a cooling labor market (weakest IMSS hiring since 2020), peso appreciation and a less restrictive Fed. Versus the previous ata (Minuta 2025-12-18, a 4-1 cut, composite -1.0), the board has stepped from active easing to a pause, so the collective message is a notch LESS dovish than December even as the underlying bias stays toward resuming cuts. The clear hawkish counterweight is Jonathan Heath, who argues 2025 saw no real disinflation progress despite a restrictive stance, that the 3% target has been met only twice in 23 years, and that a single-meeting pause is insufficient -- calling instead for a prolonged pause and patience through at least H1 2026. Core dynamics remain the binding concern (core rose to 4.47% and convergence to 3% was pushed out to Q2 2027), which keeps the pause unanimous, but the majority's emphasis on transitory shocks and space to keep cutting tilts the minutes to a mildly dovish -0.5.

key_quotes.quote: Así, la Junta de Gobierno, con la presencia de todos sus miembros, decidió por unanimidad mantener el objetivo para la Tasa de Interés Interbancaria a un día en 7.00%.
key_quotes.context: Collegial decision: unanimous pause holding the rate at 7.00% after five straight 25bp cuts; Heath rejoins the majority (his dissent is only on the communique text)

key_quotes.quote: Consideró que ante las repercusiones hasta ahora acotadas y focalizadas de las nuevas medidas, lo cual mitiga los riesgos de observar efectos de segundo orden, la pausa actual pudiera incluso ser más corta de lo previsto.
key_quotes.context: A member frames the pause as possibly shorter than expected given the contained, focalized fiscal shock -- a dovish tilt to the forward path not conveyed by the neutral communique

key_quotes.quote: Consideró adecuado comunicar que existe espacio para continuar con los recortes, procurando la convergencia eficiente a la meta y un ajuste ordenado de la economía.
key_quotes.context: A member argues the board should communicate there is room to continue cutting, given slack, dollar weakness/peso appreciation and a less restrictive Fed; signals an underlying easing bias

key_quotes.quote: Mencionó que el pausar solamente en esta ocasión no es suficiente, sino que se debe hacer una pausa prolongada hasta obtener evidencia de avances adicionales en la convergencia.
key_quotes.context: Heath (hawkish counterweight): a single-meeting pause is insufficient; wants a prolonged pause and patience through at least H1 2026 until there is evidence of further convergence
